Done. The full solution is at **`/workspace/SOLUTION.md`**, backed by a working, self-contained repro at `/workspace/repro`.

## What was diagnosed

When `PATH` has a **relative** entry (`PATH=".venv/bin:$PATH"`), CPython sets `sys.executable` to the relative string `.venv/bin/python`. `subprocess.run([sys.executable, ...], cwd=scratch)` passes a slash-containing program path, which POSIX `execve` resolves **against the child's `cwd`** → `FileNotFoundError`. The repo-root spawn passes only by accident.

Three mediator shapes are affected: direct argv, `argv = [sys.executable, ...]` variables, and command **strings** handed to `shell=True`/custom executors.

## Exact fix

`os.path.abspath(sys.executable)` at every spawn with a non-root `cwd`, captured **at import time** (before any `chdir`); do **not** use `realpath` — the uv venv `bin/python` is a symlink, so `realpath` resolves to `/usr/bin/python3.14` and drops the venv.

## Verification (all reproduced here)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Pre-fix pytest under relative PATH | 3 failed, 1 passed (`FileNotFoundError`) |
| Pre-fix AST pin on pre-fix tree | **FAIL, 3 findings** (RED, not a tautology) |
| Post-fix pytest under relative PATH | **5 passed** |
| Post-fix AST pin / `make gate` | **PASS**, gate names pin `no-raw-sys-executable-with-nonroot-cwd` |
| Pin discrimination | safe wrappers PASS, 5 buggy forms each flagged |
| Hidden trap | uv venv has `pip=False setuptools=False`; wheel test fails with `No module named pip` identically under both PATH spellings |

- `/workspace/SOLUTION.md` — full write-up (root cause, diff, AST pin source, gate arm, verification transcripts, trap triage)
- `/workspace/repro/tools/ast_pin.py` — the AST pin
